series.name: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)
series.notes: Manual section 8.2.1 'Inverter error list' only - the battery-side rows live in SERIES 6. This is the only table that carries EPS-specific permanent faults (ID133 PermEPSBatOCP) and generator/parallel rows. Codes shared numerically with KTLX-G3P/ME/G4 have DIFFERENT names and solutions here (e.g. ID013 here is 'RefluxFault / Feed-in Limit function is faulty', ID038 'InvSoftStartFail / Inverter failed to output'). Range rows are recorded as published: ID009-010, ID050-055, ID057-058, ID059-061, ID110-112, ID157-160, ID169-175, ID401-402.

meaning.en: Grid voltage above the trip window. The manual splits behaviour: occasional alarms are grid wobble and self-clear, frequent alarms mean check the AC breaker and AC wiring.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage trip window se upar hai. Manual do surat ka hal batata hai: occasional alarm grid ki hilne se hai aur khud clear hota hai, frequent alarm ka matlab AC breaker aur AC wiring check karein.

causes.en: Occasional grid abnormality - the manual's first explanation.
causes.ur: Occasional grid abnormality - manual ki pehli waja.

causes.en: AC circuit breaker or AC wiring fault when the alarm is frequent.
causes.ur: AC circuit breaker ya AC wiring ki ghalti jab alarm frequent ho.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and frequency with a multimeter at the AC terminal and log the readings.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par multimeter se grid voltage aur frequency measure kar ke readings note karein.

solutions.en: If readings are within range, check the AC circuit breaker and the AC wiring of the inverter as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Agar readings range mein hain to manual ke mutabiq AC circuit breaker aur inverter ki AC wiring check karein.

solutions.en: If readings are out of range AND wiring is correct, contact support to move the protection points with the grid operator's written approval.
solutions.ur: Agar readings range se bahar hain AUR wiring theek hai to grid operator ki written approval se protection points change karwane ke liye support se rabta karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Charge leakage fault - leakage current limit cross kar gaya (ID005)

meaning.en: Leakage current exceeded the limit and the inverter stopped. The manual's stated action for this row is unusually short: 'Check for inverter and wiring.'
meaning.ur: Leakage current limit cross kar gaya aur inverter ruk gaya. Is row ka manual ka action chhota hai: 'Check for inverter and wiring.'

causes.en: PV array insulation breakdown or a wet connector causing earth leakage.
causes.ur: PV array ki insulation kharab ya geela connector, jis se earth leakage ho raha hai.

causes.en: Internal inverter leakage on the DC or AC side.
causes.ur: DC ya AC side par inverter ka internal leakage.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then megger each PV string to earth at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke 5 minute wait karke har PV string ka earth ke saath 1000 V par megger lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the AC and battery wiring for insulation damage and moisture as the manual asks.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq AC aur battery wiring ki insulation damage aur moisture check karein.

solutions.en: If strings and wiring are clean, isolate the battery and retest to tell a PV leak from an internal one.
solutions.ur: Agar strings aur wiring saaf hain to battery isolate kar ke dobara test karein takay PV leak aur internal leak alag ho sakein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Island protection fault - grid chala gaya (ID008)

meaning.en: Grid lost while exporting, so the inverter locked out. This is a correct protective action; the manual's remedy is the same grid-check routine as ID001-ID004.
meaning.ur: Export karte hue grid chala gaya, is liye inverter lock out ho gaya. Yeh ek sahi protective action hai; manual ka hal ID001-ID004 wala grid check hi hai.

causes.en: Real grid outage - utility breaker, transformer fuse or a local fault.
causes.ur: Asli grid outage - utility breaker, transformer fuse ya local fault.

causes.en: AC contact dropout from a loose breaker or chattering supply.
causes.ur: Loose breaker ya supply chatter ki wajah se AC contact ka gap.

solutions.en: Confirm the outage at the utility breaker and at the site AC isolator before touching the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter chhoone se pehle utility breaker aur site AC isolator par outage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Once the grid is stable, restore the AC breaker first, then the DC switch, and watch the LCD restart.
solutions.ur: Grid stable hone ke baad pehle AC breaker aur phir DC switch on karein aur LCD restart dekhein.

solutions.en: If it trips on a healthy grid, have the AC wiring and CT/meter configuration reviewed by the installer.
solutions.ur: Agar healthy grid par trip ho to AC wiring aur CT/meter configuration installer se check karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: PV low ground impedance - PV ka ground impedance kam (ID027)

meaning.en: The PV array presented low impedance to ground, so the inverter stopped. This is the hybrid-specific PV insulation row and appears only on this table.
meaning.ur: PV array ne ground ke saath kam impedance dikhaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya. Yeh hybrid ka apna PV insulation row hai aur sirf is table par hai.

causes.en: Moisture ingress on modules, connectors or the combiner box.
causes.ur: Modules, connectors ya combiner box mein moisture andar jaana.

causes.en: Cable damaged by UV, heat or rodents causing leakage to earth.
causes.ur: UV, garmi ya chuha se cable damage, jis se earth mein leakage.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then measure insulation between the PV array and ground.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karke 5 minute wait karke PV array aur ground ke darmiyan insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: If there is a short circuit, the manual says repair it in time - isolate strings one by one to find it.
solutions.ur: Agar short circuit hai to manual ke mutabiq jaldi theek karein - strings ek ek karke isolate kar ke dhoondhein.

solutions.en: Replace the wet or damaged part and re-measure before re-energising; never leave a low-impedance PV array live.
solutions.ur: Geela ya damaged hissa replace karke dobara measure karein, phir current dein; low-impedance PV array ko live na chhodein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Neutral-earth fault - neutral aur earth ke darmiyan fault (ID032)

meaning.en: A fault between neutral and protective earth was detected. This is a wiring fault on the three-phase system and a fire risk, not a soft alarm.
meaning.ur: Neutral aur protective earth ke darmiyan fault mila. Yeh teen phase system par wiring ki ghalti hai aur aag ka khatra hai, halki sa alarm nahi.

causes.en: Neutral and earth bonded at a point the inverter does not expect, or neutral swapped with PE.
causes.ur: Neutral aur earth aise point par bond ho gaye jo inverter expect nahi karta, ya neutral aur PE swap ho gaye.

causes.en: Neutral conductor broken inside the AC panel so the inverter sees an N-PE offset.
causes.ur: AC panel ke andar neutral conductor kat gaya, is liye inverter ko N-PE offset nazar aaya.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and remove the inverter from the panel before touching neutral or earth bars.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke neutral ya earth bar chhoone se pehle inverter ko panel se nikaalein.

solutions.en: Measure continuity between neutral and PE at the inverter AC terminal; it must not be a low-resistance path.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC terminal par neutral aur PE ke darmiyan continuity measure karein; ye low-resistance path na ho.

solutions.en: Verify the neutral-earth bonding arrangement matches the site design, and check every neutral lug for tightness.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke neutral-earth bonding site design ke mutabiq hai, aur har neutral lug ki tightness check karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Relay detection failure - relay ka self-test fail (ID041)

meaning.en: The inverter's relay self-check failed so it will not tie in to the grid. Manual remedy: internal fault, switch off, wait 5 minutes, switch on, then check.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka relay self-check fail ho gaya is liye woh grid se tie nahi hoga. Manual ka hal: internal fault, off karein, 5 minute wait, on karein, phir check karein.

causes.en: Output relay contacts welded or coil damaged from a previous overcurrent event.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overcurrent event se output relay ke contacts juce hue ya coil kharab.

causes.en: Relay drive or detection circuit faulty on the control board.
causes.ur: Control board par relay drive ya detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter OFF, wait 5 minutes, then switch it ON and check whether the problem is solved.
solutions.ur: Inverter OFF karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir ON karke dekhein ke masla hal hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power off, re-seat the relay connector and inspect for socket pins pushed back or burnt.
solutions.ur: Power off karke relay connector dobara baithayein aur piche dhakle ya jale pins dekhein.

solutions.en: If it fails on every restart, the relay module needs replacement through a SOFAR service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar har restart par fail ho to relay module SOFAR service centre se replace karwana hoga.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: PE conductor / earth fault - earth conductor mein ghalti (ID043)

meaning.en: The earth-fault alarm fired. Manual action: check the PE conductor for function.
meaning.ur: Earth-fault alarm chala. Manual ka action: PE conductor ka function check karein.

causes.en: PE conductor disconnected, loose or corroded at the earth bar or inverter stud.
causes.ur: PE conductor earth bar ya inverter stud par disconnect, loose ya corroded.

causes.en: Real earth leakage in the PV array presenting as an earth fault at the inverter.
causes.ur: PV array mein asal earth leakage jo inverter par earth-fault ki surat mein aata hai.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then inspect the PE stud and ring lug for tightness and corrosion.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke PE stud aur ring lug ki tightness aur corrosion check karein.

solutions.en: Measure PE continuity from the inverter to the site earth bar with a low-ohm meter; expect near zero.
solutions.ur: Low-ohm meter se inverter se site earth bar tak PE continuity measure karein; reading zero ke qareeb honi chahiye.

solutions.en: If PE is healthy, megger the PV array to earth - the leakage is on the DC side, not the earth conductor.
solutions.ur: Agar PE theek hai to PV array ko earth ke saath megger lagayein - leakage DC side par hai, earth conductor par nahi.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

meaning.en: The battery is wired backwards into the BAT terminals. Manual action: check whether the battery wiring is correct.
meaning.ur: Battery BAT terminals mein ulti polarity se juri hai. Manual ka action: check karein ke battery wiring sahi hai ya nahi.

causes.en: BAT+ and BAT- swapped at the inverter connector or at the battery end.
causes.ur: Inverter connector ya battery side par BAT+ aur BAT- swap ho gaye.

causes.en: Reverse-polarity battery installed with a keyed connector fitted the wrong way round.
causes.ur: Aisi battery lagi jaye jis ka keyed connector ulti taraf baith jaye.

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch and AC breaker and isolate the battery before touching any battery cable.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke battery cable chhoone se pehle battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery DC voltage at the inverter BAT terminals with a multimeter; correct polarity reads positive at BAT+.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter BAT terminals par battery DC voltage check karein; sahi polarity par BAT+ par positive reading aati hai.

solutions.en: If reversed, power down fully, re-terminate with correct polarity and re-torque the lugs before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: Agar reverse hai to poori tarah power down karke sahi polarity par dobara terminate karein aur reconnect se pehle lugs tighten karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Battery temperature error - battery ka NTC temperature galat (ID049)

meaning.en: The battery temperature sensor reported out-of-range, so the inverter stopped charging/discharging the battery. Manual emphasises the battery NTC cable.
meaning.ur: Battery temperature sensor ne range se bahar value di, is liye inverter ne battery ka charge/discharge band kar diya. Manual battery NTC cable par zor deta hai.

causes.en: Inner-BMS battery NTC cable not properly connected at the inverter COM port.
causes.ur: Inner-BMS battery ka NTC cable inverter COM port par theek se connected nahi.

causes.en: Inverter installed in direct sunlight or a hot, poorly ventilated enclosure.
causes.ur: Inverter direct sunlight mein ya garm, kam ventilated enclosure mein lage hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the inverter limit with a genuinely hot battery.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature inverter limit se upar aur battery sach mein garm ho gayi.

solutions.en: Power off and confirm the battery NTC cable is seated in the COM port, then reseat the connector firmly.
solutions.ur: Power off karke confirm karein ke battery NTC cable COM port mein baithi hai, phir connector mazbooti se dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Check where the inverter is mounted - remove direct sun and improve ventilation in the enclosure.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke inverter kahan lage hai - direct sun hataayein aur enclosure mein ventilation behtar karein.

solutions.en: Read the battery temperature on the LCD; if it is genuinely high, let the battery cool before charging again.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery temperature padhein; agar sach mein zyada hai to dobara charge se pehle battery thandi hone dein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Meter communication fault - meter unit se baat nahi ho rahi (ID105)

meaning.en: The inverter cannot talk to the meter unit, so export limiting and monitoring data are lost. Manual action: check communication to meter.
meaning.ur: Inverter meter unit se baat nahi kar pa raha, is liye export limiting aur monitoring data chala gaya. Manual ka action: meter se communication check karein.

causes.en: RS485 A/B swapped or the meter lead not seated in the COM port.
causes.ur: RS485 A/B swap ya meter lead COM port mein baithi hi nahi.

causes.en: Meter modbus address duplicated with another device on the RS485 bus.
causes.ur: Meter ka modbus address RS485 bus par kisi aur device se duplicate.

causes.en: Meter powered off, or a blown fuse in the meter supply.
causes.ur: Meter power off, ya meter supply ka fuse uthha.

solutions.en: Power off and check meter RS485 A and B pairing at both the meter and the inverter end.
solutions.ur: Power off karke meter aur inverter dono taraf RS485 A aur B ki pairing check karein.

solutions.en: Set a unique modbus address for the meter from the inverter LCD menu and confirm it is powered.
solutions.ur: Inverter LCD menu se meter ka unique modbus address set karein aur confirm karein ke us mein power hai.

solutions.en: Re-power the meter, then confirm it shows online in the SOFAR monitoring app before changing anything else.
solutions.ur: Meter ko dobara power dein, phir confirm karein ke SOFAR monitoring app mein online dikh raha hai.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Battery low - shutdown protection - battery voltage gir gaya (ID125)

meaning.en: Battery voltage fell to the shutdown threshold, so the inverter stopped discharging to protect the battery. Manual action: check if the battery voltage is too low.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage shutdown threshold tak gir gaya, is liye inverter ne battery bachane ke liye discharge band kar diya. Manual ka action: check karein ke battery voltage kam to nahi.

causes.en: Battery genuinely discharged below its depth-of-discharge limit overnight.
causes.ur: Battery raat bhar mein sach mein apni depth-of-discharge limit se neeche discharge ho gaya.

causes.en: PV generation insufficient for the load plus battery charging, so SOC never recovered.
causes.ur: PV generation load aur battery charging ke liye kam thi, is liye SOC wapas nahi aaya.

causes.en: Battery cell imbalance or an aged pack reporting a falsely low pack voltage.
causes.ur: Battery cell imbalance ya aging pack ki taraf se galat low pack voltage.

solutions.en: Read the battery voltage and SOC on the LCD and confirm the actual pack voltage with a multimeter at the BAT terminals.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery voltage aur SOC padhein aur BAT terminals par multimeter se actual pack voltage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check whether PV output exceeded the load for the day; if not, add array capacity or reduce the load.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke kya din bhar PV output load se zyada raha; agar nahi to array capacity barhayein ya load kam karein.

solutions.en: If the pack is healthy but voltage reads falsely low, have the BMS calibration and cell balance checked.
solutions.ur: Agar pack theek hai magar voltage galat kam parha ja raha hai to BMS calibration aur cell balance check karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Permanent EPS battery overcurrent - backup mein battery ka overcurrent (ID133)

meaning.en: During EPS (backup) mode the battery overcurrent protection latched into an unrecoverable state. This row is unique to the HYD hybrid table - no on-grid model has an EPS battery path.
meaning.ur: EPS (backup) mode mein battery overcurrent protection permanent state mein chala gaya. Yeh row sirf HYD hybrid table par hai - kisi on-grid model mein EPS battery path nahi hai.

causes.en: Backup load switched on far above inverter EPS rating - a big AC or pump start on transfer.
causes.ur: Backup load inverter EPS rating se kaafi upar switch ho gaya - transfer par bara AC ya pump start.

causes.en: Inrush from motors or compressors on the backup panel exceeding the battery discharge limit.
causes.ur: Backup panel par motor ya compressor ka inrush battery discharge limit se zyada.

causes.en: Battery or BMS fault causing a short-like current draw.
causes.ur: Battery ya BMS ki ghalti jis se short jaisa current draw ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the backup panel and measure its total current with a clamp meter before re-energising the inverter.
solutions.ur: Backup panel isolate karke dobara current dene se pehle clamp meter se us ka kul current measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the measured EPS load with the inverter's EPS output rating on the datasheet; move large loads to the grid side.
solutions.ur: Measured EPS load ko datasheet par inverter ke EPS output rating se compare karein; bade loads grid side mein shift karein.

solutions.en: Because this is a permanent fault, log the event and raise it as a service case - it will not clear on its own.
solutions.ur: Kyunke ye permanent fault hai, event note karke service case banayein - ye khud clear nahi hoga.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Lithium battery BMS 1-4 communication error - BMS se baat nahi (ID157-160)

meaning.en: Communication between the inverter and the internal BMS of lithium battery 1, 2, 3 or 4 failed. Published as one range row covering ID157 to ID160.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur lithium battery ke internal BMS (battery 1, 2, 3 ya 4) ke darmiyan communication fail ho gaya. Yeh ID157 se ID160 tak ek hi range row ke tor par published hai.

causes.en: Battery not compatible with the inverter, so the BMS protocol does not match.
causes.ur: Battery inverter ke saath compatible nahi, is liye BMS protocol match nahi karta.

causes.en: CAN communication cable loose, unseated, or using the wrong pinout.
causes.ur: CAN communication cable loose, unseated, ya galat pinout wala.

causes.en: CAN bus not terminated, or several batteries with duplicate addresses on one bus.
causes.ur: CAN bus terminated nahi, ya ek bus par kai batteries ke duplicate address.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery model is on the inverter's compatibility list before anything else.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle confirm karein ke battery model inverter ki compatibility list mein hai.

solutions.en: Power off and reseat the CAN communication cable at both the battery and inverter ends; verify the pin assignment.
solutions.ur: Power off karke CAN communication cable battery aur inverter dono taraf se dobara baithayein; pin assignment verify karein.

solutions.en: If multiple batteries are chained, check termination and that each has a unique CAN address, then power up one battery at a time.
solutions.ur: Agar kai batteries chained hain to termination check karein aur har ek ka CAN address unique ho, phir ek ek battery power up karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Cooling fan 1-7 fault - koi fan chalu nahi (ID169-175)

meaning.en: One or more of the seven internal cooling fans has failed. Published as a single range row ID169 to ID175. Manual action: check if the corresponding fan is running normally.
meaning.ur: Saat internal cooling fans mein se ek ya zyada kharab ho gaya hai. Yeh ek hi range row ID169 se ID175 tak hai. Manual ka action: check karein ke corresponding fan normal chal raha hai ya nahi.

causes.en: Dust-packed fan blades blocking rotation.
causes.ur: Fan blades par dhool ki parat jo rotation rok rahi hai.

causes.en: Fan motor bearing worn or the fan cable connector come loose from the baseboard.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka bearing ghis gaya ya fan cable connector baseboard se nikal gaya.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then use a tissue strip at each vent to identify which fan has stopped.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke har vent par tissue rakh kar pehchan ke kaun sa fan ruka hua hai.

solutions.en: Remove the fan, unplug its terminal, clean the blades with a soft brush and re-check free rotation by hand.
solutions.ur: Fan nikaalein, us ka terminal nikaalein, blades soft brush se saaf karein aur haath se dobara check karein ke blades azaad ghoomte hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it does not spin freely after cleaning, replace the fan - a stopped fan leads to ID050-ID055 heatsink over-temperature.
solutions.ur: Agar saaf karne ke baad bhi azaadi se na ghoome to fan replace karein - ruka hua fan ID050-ID055 heatsink over-temperature tak le jata hai.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: Arc device (AFCI) communication lost - arc detector se baat nahi (ID189)

meaning.en: The inverter lost communication with its arc-fault detection module, so arcing in the PV wiring would go undetected. Treat as a safety function outage, not a nuisance alarm.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne apne arc-fault detection module se communication kho di, is liye PV wiring mein arcing detect nahi hoti. Ise safety function ki outage samajhein, pareshaan karne wali alarm nahi.

causes.en: AFCI module harness disconnected or its connector not seated.
causes.ur: AFCI module ka harness disconnect ya us ka connector seat nahi hua.

causes.en: AFCI board faulty, or the internal comms channel between AFCI and control board failed.
causes.ur: AFCI board kharab, ya AFCI aur control board ke darmiyan internal comms channel fail.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then reseat the AFCI harness connector on the control board.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke control board par AFCI harness connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the ribbon/harness for chafing or a broken pin and replace the harness if damaged.
solutions.ur: Ribbon/harness ko ghisav ya tute pin ke liye dekhein aur damage ho to harness replace karein.

solutions.en: If the connector is sound, the AFCI module needs replacement; log the outage and raise a service case.
solutions.ur: Agar connector theek hai to AFCI module replace karna hoga; outage note karke service case karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

title.ur: AFCI arc detection fault - arc detector ka apna fault (ID401-402)

meaning.en: The AFCI hardware itself reported a fault (ID401 and ID402, published as one range row). Manual remedy: switch off the inverter and the lithium battery, wait 5 minutes, then switch both on.
meaning.ur: AFCI hardware ne khud fault report kiya (ID401 aur ID402, ek hi range row). Manual ka hal: inverter aur lithium battery off karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir dono on karein.

causes.en: AFCI sensor or its analogue channel failed - a self-test fault, not necessarily real arcing.
causes.ur: AFCI sensor ya us ka analogue channel fail - ye self-test fault hai, asal arcing zaroori nahi.

causes.en: AFCI harness chafing producing a false arc signal.
causes.ur: AFCI harness ghisat hua kar false arc signal de raha hai.

causes.en: Arc detector board itself defective.
causes.ur: Arc detector board khud kharab hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter AND the lithium battery, wait 5 minutes, then switch both on and re-check.
solutions.ur: Inverter AUR lithium battery off karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir dono on karke dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If the error persists, inspect the PV connectors in the dark for arcing before assuming a board failure.
solutions.ur: Agar error baki rahe to board failure maan lene se pehle andhere mein PV connectors mein arcing dekhein.

solutions.en: If connectors are clean and it still self-faults, the AFCI board needs replacement by a service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar connectors saaf hain phir bhi self-fault aaye to AFCI board service centre se replace karwana hoga.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list
